title: AltCOmmand
description: AltCommand is a shortcut plugin for certain commands.
body:
AltCommand is a shortcut plugin for certain commands.

Commands:
  Time:
  
    /day
    
    /night
    
    /midnight
    
    /noon
-------------------------
  Effects:
  
    /regeneration {Time | infinite}{strength}{true | false | Ø}
    
    /jump_boost {Time | infinite}{strength}{true | false | Ø}
      ETC...
--------------------------
  Weather:
  
    /rain
    
    /clearrain
    
    /storm

Other commands like these are available to save you time.
